What to record: Identify the project, room, assembly, finish schedule, and active revision.
Record applicator, inspector, or handoff owner plus the relevant date.
Identify substrate, product, color, sheen, lot, and current instructions.
Record approved sample, specification, manufacturer sheet, drawing, or signed standard.
Record sealer, topcoat, catalyst, ratio, induction, pot life, and batch.
Record spray or brush method, tip, pressure, wet film target, and test panel.
Record each coat time, sanding grit, cleaning, and recoat interval.
Record cure condition, sheen, clarity, defects, repair, and handling release.
Example: Satin even / one dust nib repaired
